item.title: EplayerX 1.2.25
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 优化媒体信息的展开和收起动画，修正翻转方向、残影及下方内容重叠的问题。 - 改善首页、详情页和媒体列表的加载占位及内容过渡，减少闪烁和重复入场动画。 - 提升首页刷新时封面显示的稳定性，改善部分媒体分级标签的识别与显示。 - 统一历史记录、收藏及媒体浏览页面的返回操作，改善导航体验。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved media information expand and collapse animations, fixing the fold direction, ghosting, and overlap with content below. - Refined loading placeholders and content transitions across Home, detail pages, and media lists to reduce flicker and repeated entrance animations. - Improved artwork stability when Home refreshes and recognition and display of certain content rating labels. - Made back navigation more consistent across history, favorites, and media browsing pages.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
